selectedRecords.title: CADMUS.
selectedRecords.rationale: Cadmus has a bounded founding-of-Thebes sequence with explicit actors, conflict, and outcome.

selectedRecords.title: Trojan war.
selectedRecords.rationale: The Paris and Helen opening has a coherent arc from prophecy to abduction; the truncated following passage is omitted.

selectedRecords.title: The Apple of Discord
selectedRecords.rationale: The wedding of Peleus and Thetis through Paris' appointment is a coherent Apple of Discord subepisode.

selectedRecords.title: III
selectedRecords.rationale: The selected passages support a bounded Vulcan retaliation and Bacchus-luring subepisode ending with Vulcan led to Olympus.

selectedRecords.title: The Story of Endymion
selectedRecords.rationale: The Endymion section is short, complete, and has explicit divine action and outcome.

selectedRecords.title: HERCULES.
selectedRecords.rationale: The infant Hercules serpent episode is verified as a coherent subepisode after excluding prefatory quotation material.

selectedRecords.title: THE CALYDONIAN HUNT.
selectedRecords.rationale: The Calydonian Hunt passage group contains a full birth omen, hunt, conflict, and death outcome.

selectedRecords.title: OEDIPUS.
selectedRecords.rationale: The Oedipus section is a complete narrative from exposure to exile with clear source support.

selectedRecords.title: Pegasus and his silvery wings.
selectedRecords.rationale: The Bellerophon, Pegasus, and Chimera passage group is a coherent heroic episode with aftermath.

selectedRecords.title: JASON.
selectedRecords.rationale: The Jason proposal ends inside the Phryxus and Helle recital and needs a larger Golden Fleece boundary reconstruction.

selectedRecords.title: BELLEROPHON.
selectedRecords.rationale: The Berens Bellerophon proposal contains only the accusation and dangerous-mission setup, not the completed Chimera episode.

selectedRecords.title: BELLEROPHON.
selectedRecords.rationale: The Guerber Bellerophon setup stops at Minerva's bridle and should be reviewed with the following Chimera passages.

selectedRecords.title: The Love of Apollo
selectedRecords.rationale: The section mixes the complete Clytie episode with the opening of Daphne, so a single clean episode boundary is not present.

selectedRecords.title: Alcmene and Zeus.
selectedRecords.rationale: The proposal combines several Zeus exempla, including Semele, Io, Danae, Philemon and Baucis, and Lycaon.

selectedRecords.title: Perseus
selectedRecords.rationale: The Baker Perseus proposal is a valid narrative opening but stops before Medusa is reached.

selectedRecords.title: PERSEUS.
selectedRecords.rationale: The Guerber Perseus opening stops after Danae's confinement and rescue setup, before a complete episode outcome.

selectedRecords.title: Orpheus broken-hearted.
selectedRecords.rationale: The Orpheus passage starts after Eurydice's death and stops before the underworld bargain is resolved.

selectedRecords.title: Meleager.
selectedRecords.rationale: The proposal is mislabeled as Meleager but is actually a Jason and Golden Fleece fragment that needs boundary correction.

selectedRecords.title: But this fair goddess awkwardly tripped and fell on a solemn
selectedRecords.rationale: The selected passages combine a Ganymede fragment with Philemon and Baucis, producing a mixed record.

selectedRecords.title: NAPAEAE AND OREADES.
selectedRecords.rationale: The Echo and Narcissus story is embedded inside a nymph taxonomy section and requires extraction as a narrower passage.

selectionRationale: The batch favors short, source-bounded narratives with named actors, visible conflict or transformation, and evidence-linked events.
Records already covered by the six verified seed stories were not selected as new batch candidates.
Some partial or ambiguous records were intentionally included to document non-verification outcomes for later reviewers.
